title: Flashscore Match Betting Odds
description: Extract betting odds from Flashscore for football and basketball matches

startUrls.title: Match URLs
startUrls.description: Flashscore match URLs to extract odds for. Either startUrls or matchIds must be provided. Each URL must contain '/match/' in the path (e.g., https://www.flashscore.com/match/football/leeds-tUxUbLR2/tottenham-UDg08Ohm/?mid=nclkvV1t).

matchIds.title: Match IDs
matchIds.description: Flashscore match IDs to extract odds for (alternative to startUrls). These are the same match_id values output by the flashscore-extractor actor. Either startUrls or matchIds must be provided.

oddsType.title: Odds Type
oddsType.description: Which odds to return. 'Both' (the default) returns everything the match publishes: the pre-match lines, plus the in-play prices once the match has kicked off — each market tagged with odds_type so you can tell them apart. 'Pre-match' returns only the current and opening pre-match lines, the only odds that exist before kick-off. 'Live' returns only in-play prices, including in-play-only markets such as next goal; these appear at kick-off and are kept after the match ends, so a match that has not started returns nothing.

betTypes.title: Bet Types
betTypes.description: Filter which bet types to include. Bet types differ by sport: football matches offer HOME_DRAW_AWAY, OVER_UNDER, BOTH_TEAMS_TO_SCORE and DOUBLE_CHANCE; basketball matches offer HOME_DRAW_AWAY, HOME_AWAY, OVER_UNDER and ASIAN_HANDICAP. Selecting only bet types the match does not offer returns a match with no odds, so leave this empty (the default) to get every market the match publishes.

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of match items to extract. Leave empty for no limit.
